subject.title: [Bug] QQ Bot: skill_workshop approval "Allow" button always recorded as rejected

question: Should a QQ Bot direct-chat participant admitted only by an open or wildcard DM policy be allowed to resolve plugin and exec approvals without a concrete approver entry?
rationale: Chat admission and privileged approval authority are intentionally separate today; changing that boundary affects every powerful approval-backed operation and cannot be inferred safely from the bug report alone.

options.title: Preserve explicit approval authority
options.body: Keep the current fail-closed authorization rule and improve button targeting or denial guidance so users can configure a concrete approver without waiting for a timeout.

options.title: Trust direct-chat participants
options.body: Allow implicit C2C approval only after maintainers explicitly accept the escalation model and require threat-model documentation plus live QQ proof for open, wildcard, and explicitly allowlisted DM configurations.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit approval authority
recommendation.body: Keep the current fail-closed authorization rule and improve button targeting or denial guidance so users can configure a concrete approver without waiting for a timeout.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the merger and follow-up work on the exact fallback approval authorization boundary.
